claims.report_quote: `Envelope.retry_copy()` builds a new `Envelope` without `context`, so `context` becomes `None`.
claims.reason: First mail attempt after admin rotation loses its original authenticated linked account on retry, then north maintenance credential reads operations mailbox; later healthy reads do not all leak.
Admin-only legitimate rotation suffices; attacker needs own read credential and must be next mail caller.
